in_marathi.name: Sarun
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Shining, radiant, golden
in_marathi.long_meaning: Sarun हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। One who has a shining and radiant personality, often associated with the sun and the color gold. In Hindu mythology, Saraswati, the goddess of knowledge and wisdom, is often depicted as having a golden complexion.
